SELECT  "t0"."code" AS "code",
( 
                ((:env_<id>_probe_lo IS NULL AND :env_<id>_probe_hi IS NOT NULL AND "t0"."unit_price"<=:env_<id>_probe_hi) OR
                (:env_<id>_probe_lo IS NOT NULL AND :env_<id>_probe_hi IS NULL AND "t0"."unit_price">=:env_<id>_probe_lo) OR
                (:env_<id>_probe_lo IS NOT NULL AND :env_<id>_probe_hi IS NOT NULL AND
                    "t0"."unit_price" >= :env_<id>_probe_lo AND "t0"."unit_price" <= :env_<id>_probe_hi) OR
                (:env_<id>_probe_lo IS NULL AND :env_<id>_probe_hi IS NULL))
             ) AS "probe",
"t0"."id" AS "pkey"
 FROM "invc"."invc_product" AS t0
WHERE ("t0"."__del_ts" IS NULL)
